svg.title: NetCage
svg.desc:
THE MASTER. Every raster icon is exported from this file; none is hand-edited.
The mark is a signal fanning upward behind vertical cage bars. The bars are painted in the BACKGROUND colour, so they read as gaps cut through the signal rather than as strokes laid over it — that is the whole idea of the app in one shape: the signal is still there, it just cannot get through.
Geometry and colours are identical to app/src/main/res/drawable/ic_launcher_foreground.xml and ic_launcher_background.xml. If one changes, change both — a store icon that does not match the launcher icon is how an app looks like a different app in the search results than on the phone.
Play's 512x512 listing icon is full-bleed square (no adaptive safe zone), which is why the background rect is drawn here rather than assumed.
